season.evidence: Logged SE Ridge/South Ridge ascents fall Jun (3) and Jul (1), one Apr; dated reports found run June to late July; north ridge standard season is late May-June, southeast scramble later in summer (Mountaineers, Oregon Hikers forum).

otherTracksConsidered.why: Aug 2015 north ridge ascent with SE ridge descent from Pole Creek; mixed loop, not this route alone.
May ski on the north side from Pole Creek.
South Ridge via Irving Glacier, a different line.
parent review: starts at ~2124 m near Camp Lake, not a trailhead; owner rule is complete or trailhead->summit only

facts.text: In mid-July a firm snow strip angling up and right reached the merge of the south and southeast ridges faster than the loose volcanic sand beside it.
Mid-July snow strip steepens to roughly 40 degrees for a short stretch; crampons and an axe were used
Do not try to drop the 8,000-8,200 ft cliff band on the northeast side when returning to Camp Lake; go back down the snow and scree you came up.
Camp Lake gives a sheltered campsite for this line, and the first miles of Pole Creek trail cross an exposed burn with no shade.

notes: Peakbagger matched to Middle Sister is correct. North Ridge (Hayden Glacier) already has track points. Southeast Ridge has no trailhead pin; the one track starts from Camp Lake, so no add proposed (no round-trip tracks share a confirmed start). Summit pin absent; tracks and Peakbagger agree at 44.14838,-121.78417 if the owner wants one. No missing routes: Hayden/North Ridge, SE Ridge both stored; Renfrew Glacier is logged twice only.
